text:
marco.cs: Heads-up — HazelBank reporting ~15% of API calls returning 429s between 00:00–00:05 UTC, blocking payouts. Sample req ids: req_01a, req_01b. Customer on Pro plan in eu-west-1. Logs attached.
alex.support: On it. Can you confirm exact timestamps + sample request IDs (got the two). Any recent deploys or config changes on their side?
marco.cs: No deploys from us. They said they launched a new payout job at 00:00 that fans out many requests. Pattern looks top-of-minute.
priya.oncall: I pulled tenant rate metrics — hazelbank hit ~1200 RPM vs their configured 300 RPM limit for the rolling minute. TPM spiked to ~7k. Saw a sawtooth aligned to minute boundary.
jordan.eng: Checking request traces — tons of concurrent POSTs from a single API key with almost zero retry jitter. Also seeing keepalive disabled on SDK causing many fresh connections.
jordan.eng: Response headers from a failing request show:
X-RateLimit-Limit: 300
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
Retry-After: 30
alex.support: That matches a classic minute-window alignment + retry cascade.
marco.cs: I messaged the customer — they confirmed their new job launches 500 parallel workers at 00:00 to push payouts.
alex.support: Immediate recommendations for customer: 1) stagger the job (spread over a minute or more) 2) add exponential backoff + jitter on 429s 3) reduce parallelism / switch to pooled batching 4) temporarily request quota bump. Can we do a short bump while they fix?
jordan.eng: I'll request an emergency quota bump to reduce customer impact. Suggested temp limit: 1200 RPM for 2 hours. Also adding a short shared KB snippet for best practices.
jordan.eng: Example retry snippet to recommend:
```
# exponential backoff + jitter (python)
for attempt in range(5):
    resp = requests.post(url, json=payload)
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        sleep = (2 ** attempt) * 0.1 + random.uniform(0, 0.25)
        time.sleep(sleep)
        continue
    break
```
alex.support: Also ask them to enable connection reuse / keepalive in SDKs — reduces connection churn and lets our rate limiter smooth bursts.
jordan.eng: Opened infra ticket #12345 for temporary quota bump. ETA ~5m to apply.
ratecap-bot: quota-bump succeeded for tenant hazelbank (temporary RPM=1200 until +2h) :white_check_mark:
priya.oncall: Monitoring after bump — 429s dropped to 0 within 2m. P95 latency increased ~30ms but within acceptable range for now. Continuing to watch.
marco.cs: :thumbsup: I'll relay mitigation and recommended SDK changes to HazelBank. They agreed to stagger their job and add jitter.
alex.support: I'll spin up a short KB in support docs and loop in devex to add jitter examples to the SDK readme.
jordan.eng: Follow-ups for sprint: 1) instrument per-tenant concurrent connection metric 2) add a customer-facing doc about minute-alignment bursts 3) evaluate smoothing rate limiter windows (30s buckets or sliding windows) as a product improvement.
priya.oncall: Saved request ids for postmortem: req_01a, req_01b. Will close this thread after KB created. Thanks everyone.
